refreshed_qr.note: The held step, answered with a fresh code. The process id is unchanged, the `txn_id` is not: `bls_damc5sgmuijs73ah014g` at the start, `bls_damc68omuijs73ah01a0` here. Echo the latest.

body.instructions: Scan the QR code on your Signal app to log in

wrong_txn_id.note: Same errcode and same message as the WhatsApp bridge: this is bridgev2's, not a connector's.

unknown_process.note: Also what a cancelled process answers from then on.

body.error: User does not have login permissions

step_cancel_unsupported.note: POST .../{step}/cancel on a live `display_and_wait`, on the bridge whose QR flow is its only flow. Both reference bridges refuse it.

body.error: Login process does not support cancelling steps

held_request_when_process_cancelled.note: The held request, after the process was cancelled underneath it. This is the 410 the Gateway maps to `login_expired`; note the errcode says cancelled, and it is NOT the `FI.MAU.LOGIN_STEP_CANCELLED` the Gateway also maps at 409.

complete.note: NOT CAPTURED. Completing a Signal login needs a human linking a device from the Signal app, so no real `complete` answer exists in this fixture set. This is bridgev2's declared shape (RespLoginComplete) and it is unverified against a real bridge — see the PR for #106.
